name: graph-engineering
description: Design the structures agents work through, not the prompts. Task graphs: split work by its real dependencies, run the diamond pattern (parallel workers, separate verifiers, one owned merge), apply the stop rule and human gates. Context loops: state objects, context isolation, loop caps, and convergence rules that keep multi-agent runs from drifting or looping forever. Knowledge graphs: the 9-stage pipeline (ontology, extraction, fusion, GraphRAG serving) for durable agent memory. Ships a Graph Engineer agent, three skills, and ten workflow commands.
